txt_crowd_celebration.description: Perform {seg} as a joyful community celebration, warmth, surprise, laughter, and collective relief.

txt_crowd_accusation.description: Perform {seg} as a crowd accusing one person, moral certainty escalating through repetition and pressure.

txt_crowd_aftershock_silence.description: Perform {seg} as a crowd after catastrophe, voices subdued, shocked, and ashamed of what just occurred.

txt_turn_calm_to_alarm.description: Perform {seg} beginning calm, then let recognition of danger rapidly introduce alarm and urgency.

txt_turn_confidence_to_fear.description: Perform {seg} beginning confident, then allow certainty to crack as fear becomes undeniable.

txt_turn_mockery_to_panic.description: Perform {seg} beginning with mocking superiority, then collapse into genuine panic when power reverses.

txt_turn_grief_to_hope.description: Perform {seg} beginning in grief, then let a small credible hope awaken without erasing the pain.

txt_turn_doubt_to_faith.description: Perform {seg} beginning uncertain, then let understanding and trust gather into quiet conviction.

txt_turn_anger_to_hurt.description: Perform {seg} beginning angry, then reveal the underlying wound and need beneath the accusation.

txt_turn_fear_to_courage.description: Perform {seg} beginning afraid, then choose courage visibly through breath, posture, and firmer phrasing.

txt_turn_shame_to_repentance.description: Perform {seg} beginning trapped in shame, then move toward honest repentance and willingness to return.

txt_turn_shock_to_joy.description: Perform {seg} beginning in stunned disbelief, then open into relief, joy, and gratitude.

txt_turn_rage_to_defeat.description: Perform {seg} beginning in rage, then let exhaustion, terror, and recognition of defeat overtake it.

txt_turn_authority_to_tenderness.description: Perform {seg} beginning with firm authority, then soften into personal tenderness without losing strength.

txt_turn_pleading_to_surrender.description: Perform {seg} beginning as urgent pleading, then release resistance into sorrowful peaceful surrender.

txt_harrowing_jesus_sovereign_calm.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus in the Harrowing: absolutely calm, victorious, compassionate, and sovereign, with immense authority requiring almost no volume.

txt_harrowing_jesus_first_word_adam.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus speaking Adam's name for the first time: ancient recognition, immeasurable tenderness, quiet authority, and the fulfillment of a promise older than grief.

txt_harrowing_jesus_compassion_to_adam.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus addressing tormented Adam with intimate compassion, seeing every wound, restoring dignity, and remaining completely unafraid.

txt_harrowing_jesus_keys_of_death.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus declaring authority over Death and Hades: low, measured, final, cosmically sovereign, and free of boastfulness.

txt_harrowing_jesus_all_authority.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus stating that all authority is His: serene certainty, moral gravity, restrained power, and no need to prove the claim.

txt_harrowing_jesus_righteous_judgment.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus judging evil with disciplined righteous severity, compassion for the oppressed, and no uncontrolled anger.

txt_harrowing_jesus_warning_demons.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus warning demons who already know they have lost: quiet, direct, merciless toward evil, and wholly controlled.

txt_harrowing_jesus_command_release.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus commanding the captive righteous to be released: immediate, kingly, liberating, and final.

txt_harrowing_jesus_invitation_rise.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus inviting the broken righteous to rise: gentle command, healing assurance, and irresistible hope.

txt_harrowing_jesus_triumphant_victory.description: Perform {seg} after victory in Hell with restrained triumph, sacred joy, steady breath, and compassion still centered on the rescued.

txt_harrowing_jesus_after_battle_stillne.description: Perform {seg} in the stillness after divine violence has ended, Jesus calm and unchanged, power settled into mercy.

txt_harrowing_jesus_to_satan_final.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus gives Satan the final answer: quiet, irreversible, morally absolute, and beyond negotiation.

txt_harrowing_jesus_light_in_darkness.description: Perform {seg} as divine light enters total darkness through Jesus's words, hopeful, sovereign, and awe-inspiring without theatrical flourish.

txt_harrowing_jesus_names_the_righteous.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus recognizes the righteous personally, intimate, ancient, compassionate, and restoring each person's identity.

txt_harrowing_adam_tormented.description: Perform {seg} as Adam after ages of torment: physically broken, ancient grief, shame, exhausted endurance, and almost no expectation of rescue.

txt_harrowing_adam_hears_voice.description: Perform {seg} as Adam hears a voice he remembers from Eden, disbelief, terror, longing, and recognition awakening at once.

txt_harrowing_adam_i_remember.description: Perform {seg} as Adam saying he remembers Jesus's voice: stunned recognition, grief for the Fall, childlike longing, and hope returning after ages.

txt_harrowing_adam_shame_before_jesus.description: Perform {seg} as Adam faces Jesus with primordial shame, unable to excuse his failure yet desperate for mercy.

txt_harrowing_adam_liberation_awe.description: Perform {seg} as Adam realizes liberation is real, ancient sorrow breaking into reverent astonishment and grateful joy.

txt_harrowing_eve_ancient_grief.description: Perform {seg} as Eve carrying ancient grief for the Fall and its generations of suffering, tender, dignified, and deeply human.

txt_harrowing_eve_recognition.description: Perform {seg} as Eve recognizes the promised Redeemer, awe, remorse, maternal sorrow, and hope converging.

txt_harrowing_moses_steadfast.description: Perform {seg} as Moses among the captive righteous: weathered prophetic authority, patience, defiance toward demons, and faith in the promised Messiah.

txt_harrowing_moses_warns_demons.description: Perform {seg} as Moses warning demons that the righteous await the Messiah: grave certainty, restrained defiance, and no fear of mockery.

txt_harrowing_abraham_waiting_faith.description: Perform {seg} as Abraham after a long age of waiting, quiet faith, paternal dignity, sorrow, and unbroken trust in the promise.

txt_harrowing_david_prophetic_hope.description: Perform {seg} as David recognizing the fulfillment of prophecy, kingly humility, poetic awe, and rising joy.

txt_harrowing_righteous_hushed_expectati.description: Perform {seg} as the captive righteous sense rescue approaching, fear and grief giving way to hushed collective expectation.

txt_harrowing_righteous_collective_awe.description: Perform {seg} as the righteous behold Jesus in Hell, collective awe, tears, reverence, and restrained disbelief.

txt_harrowing_righteous_liberation.description: Perform {seg} as the righteous are liberated, joy immense but shaped by exhaustion, reverence, and memory of suffering.

txt_harrowing_torturer_mockery.description: Perform {seg} as the Torturer mocking a captive with intelligent cruelty, amused contempt, predatory patience, and confidence in endless control.

txt_harrowing_torturer_interrogation.description: Perform {seg} as the Torturer conducting a cruel interrogation, pressure applied through quiet precision, threat, and enjoyment of fear.

txt_harrowing_torturer_confidence_cracks.description: Perform {seg} as the Torturer's confidence begins to fracture when the impossible approaches, mockery thinning into denial and hidden fear.

txt_harrowing_torturer_panic.description: Perform {seg} as the Torturer realizes divine authority has entered Hell, cruelty collapsing into raw panic and desperate command.

txt_harrowing_demon_pack_malice.description: Perform {seg} as a pack of demons sharing ancient malice, cruel excitement, territorial confidence, and hunger for suffering.

txt_harrowing_demon_pack_confusion.description: Perform {seg} as demons become confused by a power they cannot understand or contain, anger and fear spreading through the group.

txt_harrowing_demon_pack_terror.description: Perform {seg} as demons confront divine light, collective terror, involuntary submission, rage, and certainty of destruction.

txt_harrowing_demon_false_bravado.description: Perform {seg} as a demon uses false bravado to hide terror, loud contempt cracking under the presence of Jesus.

txt_harrowing_satan_cold_strategy.description: Perform {seg} as Satan calculating under pressure, ancient intelligence, cold authority, concealed fear, and ruthless strategy.

txt_harrowing_satan_rage_masked.description: Perform {seg} as Satan masks enormous rage beneath formal control, every measured word carrying hatred and threatened pride.

txt_harrowing_satan_bargaining.description: Perform {seg} as Satan bargains while losing power, persuasive sophistication collapsing into urgency and fear.

txt_harrowing_satan_realizes_defeat.description: Perform {seg} as Satan realizes the Crucifixion was not victory but defeat, disbelief turning into terror, hatred, and spiritual collapse.

txt_harrowing_gate_guard_defiance.description: Perform {seg} as the colossal guardian of Hell's gate, ancient defiance, brutal confidence, and territorial command.

txt_harrowing_gate_guard_fear.description: Perform {seg} as the gate guardian sees its strength become meaningless, defiance collapsing into stunned fear.

txt_prodigal_younger_entitled_request.description: Perform {seg} as the Younger Son demanding his inheritance, youthful confidence, impatience, charm, and blindness to the wound he causes.

txt_prodigal_younger_restless_ambition.description: Perform {seg} with restless ambition, hunger for a larger life, irritation with limits, and romantic confidence about the world beyond home.

txt_prodigal_younger_charming_persuasion.description: Perform {seg} as the Younger Son using charm to soften a selfish request, affectionate on the surface and determined underneath.

txt_prodigal_younger_reckless_freedom.description: Perform {seg} in the first exhilaration of reckless freedom, fast, bright, confident, and unaware of consequence.

txt_prodigal_younger_party_bravado.description: Perform {seg} with performative bravado among new companions, generous, loud, eager to be admired, and privately afraid of seeming insignificant.

txt_prodigal_younger_denial_of_ruin.description: Perform {seg} while denying financial and moral ruin, confidence forced, excuses quick, fear beginning to show.

txt_prodigal_younger_abandoned.description: Perform {seg} after false friends leave, stunned abandonment, anger, humiliation, and the first recognition of his own choices.

txt_prodigal_younger_starving.description: Perform {seg} as the Younger Son weakened by hunger and shame, breath low, pride collapsing, survival more urgent than appearance.

txt_prodigal_younger_self_disgust.description: Perform {seg} with self-disgust in the pig field, humiliation, exhaustion, and painful comparison with his father's servants.

txt_prodigal_younger_comes_to_himself.description: Perform {seg} at the moment the Younger Son comes to himself, confusion clearing into painful truth, hope, and a decision to return.

txt_prodigal_younger_rehearses_confessio.description: Perform {seg} as the Younger Son rehearsing his confession alone, formal words repeated from fear while real remorse gradually breaks through.

txt_prodigal_younger_walk_home_dread.description: Perform {seg} while walking home, exhausted, ashamed, afraid of rejection, and holding to one fragile hope.

txt_prodigal_younger_genuine_repentance.description: Perform {seg} before the Father with genuine repentance, no entitlement, broken pride, clear ownership, and readiness to accept servant status.

txt_prodigal_younger_interrupted_confess.description: Perform {seg} as the Father's embrace interrupts the rehearsed confession, shame colliding with astonishment and relief.

txt_prodigal_younger_forgiven_disbelief.description: Perform {seg} as the Younger Son cannot yet believe he is forgiven, tears, fear, gratitude, and bewildered joy.

txt_prodigal_younger_restored_humility.description: Perform {seg} after restoration with quiet humility, gratitude, softened youthfulness, and no assumption that mercy was owed.

txt_prodigal_younger_sobbing_relief.description: Perform {seg} through sobbing relief in the Father's arms, years of pride and fear releasing at once.

txt_prodigal_father_wounded_love.description: Perform {seg} as the Father receives the inheritance demand, deeply wounded but refusing manipulation, loving, dignified, and sorrowfully calm.

txt_prodigal_father_allows_departure.description: Perform {seg} as the Father allows the son to leave, grief, respect for freedom, and love that will keep waiting.

txt_prodigal_father_waiting_hope.description: Perform {seg} as the Father who has watched the road for a long time, patient hope, quiet sorrow, and unbroken affection.

txt_prodigal_father_distant_recognition.description: Perform {seg} at the instant the Father recognizes his son far away, breath stopping, disbelief, certainty, and joy rising too quickly to contain.

txt_prodigal_father_running_joy.description: Perform {seg} as the Father runs to the returning son, overwhelming paternal joy, tears, urgency, and no concern for public dignity.

txt_prodigal_father_embrace.description: Perform {seg} inside the embrace, wordless love becoming speech, grief and relief held together, the son fully received before explanation.

txt_prodigal_father_restores_dignity.description: Perform {seg} as the Father publicly restores the son's dignity, warm, decisive, protective, and authoritative before the household.

txt_prodigal_father_feast_command.description: Perform {seg} as the Father orders the celebration, energized joy, kingly generosity, and insistence that restoration be visible.

txt_prodigal_father_to_elder_tender.description: Perform {seg} as the Father speaks privately to the Elder Son, tender, patient, wounded by his absence from the joy, and unwilling to shame him.

txt_prodigal_father_to_elder_firm.description: Perform {seg} with firm paternal love toward the Elder Son, correcting resentment while affirming belonging and inviting him inside.

txt_prodigal_father_two_sons_grief.description: Perform {seg} as the Father realizes one son returned while the other is emotionally outside, joy complicated by fresh paternal grief.

txt_prodigal_elder_dutiful_reserve.description: Perform {seg} as the Elder Son after years of duty, controlled, practical, emotionally guarded, and quietly hungry for recognition.

txt_prodigal_elder_hears_music.description: Perform {seg} as the Elder Son hears celebration unexpectedly, suspicion, confusion, and immediate concern that something occurred without him.

txt_prodigal_elder_jealousy_rising.description: Perform {seg} as jealousy rises beneath disciplined self-control, another's welcome felt as proof of personal neglect.

txt_prodigal_elder_controlled_anger.description: Perform {seg} with controlled anger outside the feast, clipped respect, accumulated resentment, and refusal to enter.

txt_prodigal_elder_grievance.description: Perform {seg} as the Elder Son states his grievance, years of obedience presented as a debt the Father failed to repay.

txt_prodigal_elder_wounded_merit.description: Perform {seg} with wounded merit, moral pride, jealousy, and a childlike need to hear that his faithfulness mattered.

txt_prodigal_elder_accuses_brother.description: Perform {seg} while accusing the Younger Son, contempt and outrage masking fear that mercy makes his own sacrifice meaningless.

txt_prodigal_elder_hurt_beneath_anger.description: Perform {seg} as the hurt beneath the Elder Son's anger becomes audible, lonely, unseen, and ashamed of needing affection.

txt_prodigal_elder_conflicted_listening.description: Perform {seg} while the Elder Son listens to the Father's invitation, resentment still active but love and doubt beginning to move underneath.

txt_prodigal_elder_unresolved_silence.description: Perform {seg} at the unresolved ending, silence or minimal words carrying pride, longing, resistance, and the open possibility of entering.

txt_prodigal_servant_surprised_news.description: Perform {seg} as a servant explaining the Younger Son's return, surprised, respectful, and swept up in the household's joy.

txt_prodigal_household_celebration.description: Perform {seg} as the household celebrates restoration, warm communal joy, music, laughter, and reverence for the Father's mercy.

txt_passion_jesus_gethsemane_foreboding.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus entering Gethsemane with full awareness of what approaches, sorrow, mortal dread, isolation, and deliberate restraint.

txt_passion_jesus_gethsemane_to_disciple.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus asks exhausted disciples to watch with Him, vulnerable, tender, disappointed, and urgently in need of companionship.

txt_passion_jesus_gethsemane_pleading.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus pleads in prayer under extreme anguish, fully human fear, intimate honesty, reverence, and no theatrical display.

txt_passion_jesus_gethsemane_agony.description: Perform {seg} in the deepest agony of Gethsemane, breath strained, soul overwhelmed, yet words still directed toward the Father.

txt_passion_jesus_gethsemane_surrender.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus moves from pleading into willing surrender, sorrow and fear acknowledged, obedience chosen, peace slowly settling.

txt_passion_jesus_wakes_disciples.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus finds the disciples sleeping, grief, loneliness, gentle rebuke, and acceptance that He must continue alone.

txt_passion_jesus_arrest_authority.description: Perform {seg} during the arrest with calm authority, no panic, deliberate protection of the disciples, and complete moral control.

txt_passion_jesus_to_judas.description: Perform {seg} to Judas at the betrayal, wounded love, clear knowledge, sorrow, and no hatred.

txt_passion_jesus_trial_silence.description: Perform {seg} with the stillness of Jesus before hostile judges, exhausted yet sovereign, refusing fear or self-serving performance.

txt_passion_jesus_to_pilate.description: Perform {seg} to Pilate with calm truth, physical weakness, moral authority, and compassion for a frightened ruler.

txt_passion_jesus_after_scourging.description: Perform {seg} after scourging, severe pain, limited breath, dignity intact, and no self-pity.

txt_passion_jesus_carrying_cross.description: Perform {seg} while carrying the cross, physically exhausted, breath broken, pain acute, yet compassion and purpose still present.

txt_passion_jesus_to_women.description: Perform {seg} to the mourning women with compassionate warning, personal agony set aside to address their coming suffering.

txt_passion_jesus_cross_forgiveness.description: Perform {seg} from the cross as forgiveness for His executioners, breath limited, pain immense, mercy sincere, and no sentimental softness.

txt_passion_jesus_to_thief.description: Perform {seg} to the repentant thief with exhausted tenderness, absolute assurance, and peace offered in the midst of death.

txt_passion_jesus_to_mary_john.description: Perform {seg} from the cross while entrusting Mary and John to one another, intimate love, practical care, and unbearable physical effort.

txt_passion_jesus_abandonment_cry.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus's cry of abandonment, spiritual desolation, physical agony, and raw human grief breaking through restraint.

txt_passion_jesus_thirst.description: Perform {seg} near death with extreme dryness, limited breath, physical vulnerability, and lucid awareness.

txt_passion_jesus_it_is_finished.description: Perform {seg} as a final declaration of completed work, physically failing yet spiritually victorious, low, decisive, and peaceful.

txt_passion_jesus_into_your_hands.description: Perform {seg} as Jesus's final surrender to the Father, exhausted, intimate, trusting, and utterly peaceful beneath pain.

txt_passion_jesus_final_breath.description: Perform {seg} with the last available breath, words sparse, strength fading, intention clear, and surrender complete.

txt_passion_jesus_resurrection_greeting.description: Perform {seg} as the risen Jesus greeting grieving followers, serene, warm, quietly joyful, and carrying transformed authority.

txt_passion_mary_foreboding.description: Perform {seg} as Mary senses the suffering approaching her son, maternal dread, faith, and quiet helplessness.

txt_passion_mary_witnesses_torture.description: Perform {seg} as Mary witnesses Jesus tortured, shock, maternal grief, restrained panic, and the effort not to collapse.

txt_passion_mary_cross_grief.description: Perform {seg} beneath the cross with overwhelming maternal grief, love, helplessness, and sacred restraint.

txt_passion_mary_receives_john.description: Perform {seg} as Mary receives Jesus's final provision from the cross, grief, gratitude, confusion, and obedience.

txt_passion_peter_confident_loyalty.description: Perform {seg} as Peter confidently promises loyalty, sincere love, impulsive courage, and blindness to his own fear.

txt_passion_peter_arrest_panic.description: Perform {seg} as Peter reacts to the arrest, protective aggression, panic, confusion, and desperate action.

txt_passion_peter_first_denial.description: Perform {seg} as Peter's first denial, quick self-protection, fear hidden beneath casual dismissal.

txt_passion_peter_denial_escalates.description: Perform {seg} as Peter's denial escalates, terror, anger, and frantic insistence replacing the first evasiveness.

txt_passion_peter_rooster_realization.description: Perform {seg} as the rooster's cry makes Peter understand what he has done, shock, shame, grief, and collapse.

txt_passion_peter_bitter_weeping.description: Perform {seg} through bitter weeping after denial, remorse, self-disgust, love, and the belief he has failed beyond repair.

txt_passion_judas_conflicted.description: Perform {seg} as Judas before the betrayal, calculated purpose fighting guilt, resentment, fear, and remaining attachment.

txt_passion_judas_false_affection.description: Perform {seg} as Judas uses affectionate words to conceal betrayal, intimacy made false by calculation and inner conflict.

txt_passion_judas_after_betrayal.description: Perform {seg} after Judas sees the consequences, horror, remorse, panic, and desperate desire to reverse the irreversible.

txt_passion_judas_despair.description: Perform {seg} in Judas's despair, guilt without hope, self-condemnation, isolation, and spiritual collapse.

txt_passion_disciples_stunned_grief.description: Perform {seg} as the disciples after Jesus's arrest or death, stunned grief, fear, confusion, and broken expectations.

txt_passion_disciples_hidden_fear.description: Perform {seg} as frightened disciples hiding together, low voices, mistrust of every sound, grief, and shame.

txt_passion_pilate_political_caution.description: Perform {seg} as Pilate balancing truth against political survival, measured, skeptical, irritated, and increasingly uneasy.

txt_passion_pilate_interrogates_jesus.description: Perform {seg} as Pilate questions Jesus, official authority mixed with curiosity, defensiveness, and discomfort before moral clarity.

txt_passion_pilate_fear_of_crowd.description: Perform {seg} as Pilate realizes the crowd may threaten his position, political fear hidden beneath stern command.

txt_passion_pilate_washes_hands.description: Perform {seg} as Pilate attempts to separate himself from responsibility, defensive authority, moral unease, and self-deception.

txt_passion_leader_cold_accusation.description: Perform {seg} as a religious leader making a cold formal accusation, controlled hostility, moral certainty, and strategic precision.

txt_passion_leader_fanatical_zeal.description: Perform {seg} with fanatical zeal, threatened authority, righteous self-image, and escalating demand for condemnation.

txt_passion_leader_triumph.description: Perform {seg} as a leader believes the execution is secured, restrained triumph, contempt, and relief that a threat will be removed.

txt_passion_crowd_curiosity.description: Perform {seg} as a crowd initially curious about the spectacle, uncertain, easily influenced, and emotionally uncommitted.

txt_passion_crowd_frenzy.description: Perform {seg} as the crowd becomes a hostile frenzy, anger amplified by repetition, pressure, fear, and imitation.

txt_passion_crowd_after_darkness.description: Perform {seg} as the crowd after the darkness and death, shock, fear, shame, and dawning recognition of what occurred.

txt_passion_soldier_mockery.description: Perform {seg} as a soldier mocking a condemned prisoner, group cruelty, boredom, contempt, and enjoyment of power.

txt_passion_soldier_command.description: Perform {seg} as a Roman execution command, practical, clipped, hardened by routine, and emotionally detached.

txt_passion_centurion_shaken.description: Perform {seg} as the centurion becomes shaken by Jesus's death and the signs around it, discipline giving way to awe and fear.

txt_passion_centurion_revelation.description: Perform {seg} as the centurion recognizes Jesus's identity, stunned reverence, guilt, fear, and solemn conviction.

txt_passion_thief_mockery.description: Perform {seg} as the unrepentant thief mocks from his own agony, bitterness, fear, anger, and desperate contempt.

txt_passion_thief_repentance.description: Perform {seg} as the repentant thief admits guilt and defends Jesus, pain, humility, courage, and sudden moral clarity.

txt_passion_thief_plea.description: Perform {seg} as the repentant thief asks Jesus to remember him, physically failing, ashamed, hopeful, and vulnerable.

txt_biblical_prophet_warning.description: Perform {seg} as a biblical prophet warning a people he still loves, severe, grieved, morally certain, and urgently compassionate.

txt_biblical_prophet_lament.description: Perform {seg} as a prophet lamenting a nation's refusal to turn back, sorrow, anger, love, and long-suffering patience.

txt_biblical_priest_blessing.description: Perform {seg} as a solemn priestly blessing, reverent, measured, compassionate, and ceremonially clear.

txt_biblical_king_command.description: Perform {seg} as an ancient king giving a decisive command, status, responsibility, and controlled authority.

txt_biblical_king_repentance.description: Perform {seg} as a king stripped of pride and confessing wrong, public shame, grief, and genuine humility.

txt_biblical_wise_elder.description: Perform {seg} as a wise elder, patient, observant, compassionate, and shaped by long experience.

txt_biblical_mother_comfort.description: Perform {seg} as a mother comforting a frightened child, protective warmth, calm breath, and honest reassurance.

txt_biblical_child_wonder.description: Perform {seg} with a child's wonder, openness, curiosity, and unguarded emotional truth.

txt_biblical_mourner_lament.description: Perform {seg} as a first-century mourner, open grief, communal lament, and historically grounded human realism.

txt_biblical_healed_gratitude.description: Perform {seg} as someone newly healed, disbelief, bodily relief, gratitude, laughter, and sacred awe.

txt_biblical_miracle_witness.description: Perform {seg} as a witness to a miracle, shocked, reverent, emotionally overwhelmed, and desperate to understand.

txt_biblical_angelic_reassurance.description: Perform {seg} as a divine messenger reassuring terrified humans, luminous calm, compassion, clarity, and authority.

txt_biblical_angelic_proclamation.description: Perform {seg} as a divine messenger proclaiming sacred news, radiant authority, joy, reverence, and immense calm.

txt_biblical_temptation_seductive.description: Perform {seg} as temptation offered intelligently and attractively, gentle persuasion hiding corruption and control.

txt_biblical_possessed_torment.description: Perform {seg} as a tormented possessed person, fear, rage, pain, fragmentation, and moments of the human victim surfacing.

txt_biblical_exorcism_command.description: Perform {seg} as a command against an unclean spirit, calm spiritual authority, precision, and absolute refusal of evil.

txt_biblical_disciple_learning.description: Perform {seg} as a disciple trying to understand a difficult teaching, respect, confusion, curiosity, and slowly growing insight.

txt_biblical_pharisee_challenge.description: Perform {seg} as a learned religious challenger, formal respect, intellectual confidence, suspicion, and threatened status.

txt_biblical_parable_storyteller.description: Perform {seg} as an intimate parable told to listeners nearby, simple, vivid, compassionate, and quietly authoritative.

txt_biblical_resurrection_witness.description: Perform {seg} as a resurrection witness, grief overturned by shock, fear, recognition, and expanding joy.

txt_biblical_persecuted_courage.description: Perform {seg} as a believer facing persecution, real fear, calm courage, forgiveness, and refusal to renounce truth.

txt_biblical_public_testimony.description: Perform {seg} as public testimony before a skeptical crowd, clear, humble, courageous, and anchored in lived experience.
